newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka ends weaker against dollar.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka ends weaker against dollar.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka closed easier at 43.7495/7500 to the dollar in interbank trading on Thursday ahead of the Friday weekend amid scant supplies of the U.S. currency, dealers said.
This compared with the previous close at 43.7490/7495.
The taka was quoted weaker at 43.7490/7500 per dollar in early trade and slipped again after a foreign bank bought a large volume of greenbacks for import payment.
"That purchase (by the foreign bank) further strained the supply situation," said one dealer.
Gains by dollar pushed call money rates up to eight percent to 8.5 percent at the close against a previous 6.5 percent to seven percent. Banks in Bangladesh close transactions by midday on Thursday.
